name: base_utils
description: Manages shared operating-system utilities, including an optional /etc/motd and a Hiera-controlled package list, with supporting custom types, functions, facts, and task artifacts.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Deploys and configures a full Python application stack, including application code, dependencies, PostgreSQL connection settings, workers, systemd service management, logging, backups, and health checks.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Installs and configures HAProxy with backend discovery, service management, firewall integration, statistics, logging, timeouts, custom error pages, and optional TLS.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Installs and configures PostgreSQL, including repository setup, package and version control, and service management; PostgreSQL 15 is the configured target.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Installs and configures Redis cluster nodes with password, memory, eviction-policy, and port settings, and supports node discovery through PuppetDB.
